description: Functional specifications/files: remove direct sessionless Person OAuth start/reconnect APIs and keep PeopleCredentials authenticated transaction -> session-bound prepare -> post-commit authorization; preserve separate global admin OAuth. Tests first: session expiry/revocation, permission withdrawal, replay, cancellation, failed reconnect, provider HTTP outside transaction, and removal of direct-start callers. Branches: start/reconnect/callback/error. Mocking: external OAuth HTTP only. Docs: Engine/system config/module docs. Action reuse: extend existing PeopleAuthGateway/PeopleCredentials/OAuthAttempts boundary; no parallel auth or Action.
